message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "on: [push, pull_request]

name: CI

jobs:
  fmt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Steps represent a sequence of tasks that will be executed as part of the job.
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          components: rustfmt
          override: true

      - name: Check Format
        run: cargo fmt -- --check

  build_and_test:
    name: Test
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macOS-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: sudo apt install libwayland-cursor0 libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --verbose
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --verbose
      - name: Install wasm target
        run: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - name: Check wasm build
        run: cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features

  redox:
    name: Check Redox
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Install Redox target
        run: rustup target add x86_64-unknown-redox
      - name: Check Redox build
        run: cargo check --target x86_64-unknown-redox --examples
",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Rust CI with repeated runs (CI history shows multiple successful runs) and no existing dependency cache. Cargo re-downloads registry and git dependencies on every run across the build_and_test matrix (ubuntu/windows/macOS). The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (Cache dependency downloads) applies: repeated dependency fetching is measurable, and the cache can be keyed on the runner OS plus Cargo.lock. The measured experiment batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200 reported about 20.4% elapsed savings from adding a dependency cache to a CI workflow, and the pattern reports modest aggregate VM-time reduction. The change adds a single actions/cache@v4 step for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git after checkout and before cargo build in build_and_test. It preserves all build/test coverage (no steps or tests removed), caches only dependency downloads rather than build outputs, and adds no permissions, secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or new network access beyond the existing GitHub Actions cache service.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
